title: Vercel Ship LDN — brand/event sizzle
substyle: Monochrome sizzle montage (proposed; close to Editorial)

secondary_motion: almost none: shots are near-still frames cut fast; only the mascot blinks and a few drifts
color: black and white throughout (colorfulness 5.5); rare accents: red wireframe globe, blue Geist plate, gradient beam, colored charts
typography: big type moments from the brand system: Geist Serif with highlight bars, particles forming 'PIXEL', full-frame 'If it's agentic it's on Vercel'
shape_language: precise geometry, pixel grids, triangles, circuit boards; one liquid drip as the organic exception
character_humor: the boxy robot mascot with '||' eyes, police lights and blinks; claw-machine gag

signature: A fast black-and-white montage of brand-system frames, product UI, 3D objects and event photos, each held a fraction of a second, resolved by a stepped logo build.

music.summary: Clear 99.4 BPM pulse (0.66) but cuts land on the beat below chance (15% vs 23%) and shots last a median 0.72 beats: the cuts run faster than the beat and ignore it, while the macro shape (quiet intro, louder sections from ~20 s and ~40 s, decay under the logo) follows the music.

family_note: Restrained tone (4.0) and monochrome discipline put it in 01 Elegant; the change-by-snap grammar is closest to Editorial (ref02). It differs from the existing Elegant refs by its montage density (60 cuts/min, cut-driven rhythm) and the event/brand sizzle format, hence a proposed sub-style. Could also be read as a calm-toned showreel.

behaviors.mechanism: triangle mark appears large, then snaps smaller in held steps (no tween) while moving left to make room
behaviors.notes: f1714-f1727: sqrt(area) 192 -> 138 -> 107 -> 69, each step held 4-5 f; final mark is about 36% of the first size

behaviors.mechanism: wordmark 'Vercel' types on letter by letter to the right of the mark
behaviors.notes: f1732-f1742: right edge steps every 2 f (1061, 1091, 1125, 1158, 1197, 1210 px); the mark slides left on the same steps. Then a 2 s hold

behaviors.mechanism: hard cuts between near-still frames (brand-system posters, UI, 3D renders, event photos), many held under one beat
behaviors.notes: 60.4 cuts/min, median shot 0.72 beats (~435 ms); burst of 3-6 f shots at 45-53 s (sheet e_cut_burst)

behaviors.mechanism: music-sync: clear beat but cuts deliberately off it (below chance); only section changes follow the music
behaviors.notes: 99.4 BPM, pulse 0.66; cuts on beat 14.8% vs chance 23.2%; accents on beat 14.3%

behaviors.mechanism: a field of pixel glyphs and shapes rains down and resolves into the word 'PIXEL' in the pixel typeface, then the word breaks into icon blocks that line up
behaviors.notes: f429-f449 form, f484-f524 icon blocks pop in one by one about every 5 f; read from sheets

behaviors.mechanism: black highlight bars wipe across a serif headline letter-group by letter-group, inverting it to white on black
black liquid simulation dripping over a hidden triangle on white (the mark implied by fluid), then cut to a circuit board that lights up
robot mascot's '||' eyes squash to '..' and back (blink), police lights flash
behaviors.notes: f304-f309 and f1689-f1699 (eyes alone on black before the logo); read from sheets

behaviors.mechanism: 3D triangle mascot rotates in the dark, rim light traces its edge, fades until only the eyes are left, eyes blink and vanish, then the flat logo snaps in
